newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 30.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 30.

text.p: * CompUSA Inc reported fiscal first quarter earnings of $0.31 a share, up from $0.15 a year ago. The First Call estimate was $0.26. CompUSA shares closed at 51-1/2 on Tuesday.
* CIGNA Corp is expected to report third quarter earnings of $3.18 a share, compared to a loss of $7.94 a year earlier, according to First Call. The stock closed at 127-1/4.
* Wang Laboratories Inc is expected to report a fiscal first quarter loss of $0.02 a share, compared to a profit of $0.04 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 22-3/8.
* Viacom Inc is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $0.15, compared to $0.17 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 31-3/4.
* Bethlehem Steel Corp is expected to report third quarter earnings per share of $0.11, compared to $0.22 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at eight.
* Selective high tech stocks bounced back in London overnight. Compaq Computer Corp was up 3/8 at 67-7/8, Digital Equipment Corp was up 1/4 at 29-3/4, and Hewlett-Packard Co was up 3/8 at 44-5/8.
